title: BinXSight: Fast Binary Program Summarization via Hierarchical Modular Decomposition
abstract: arXiv:2611.27816v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Binary code summarization (BCS) is crucial in fields such as cybersecurity. Particularly, program-level BCS can quickly provide a comprehensive overview of an entire stripped binary without in-depth manual reverse engineering. However, a binary often contains numerous functions with complex interactions, making it challenging to extract its functionality efficiently. Moreover, existing methods focus solely on function-level without considering contextual information, limiting their applicability to program-level analysis. Towards comprehensive and fast program-level BCS, we propose BinXSight, an LLM-powered framework based on hierarchical modular decomposition. translated_title: BinXSight：通过分层模块化分解实现快速二进制程序摘要
translated_abstract: 二进制代码摘要在网络安全等领域至关重要。特别是，程序级二进制代码摘要能够在无需深入人工逆向工程的情况下，快速提供整个去除符号的二进制文件的全面概述。然而，二进制文件通常包含大量具有复杂交互关系的函数，这使得高效提取其功能变得极具挑战性。此外，现有方法仅关注函数级别而未考虑上下文信息，限制了其在程序级分析中的适用性。为实现全面且快速的程序级二进制代码摘要，我们提出了BinXSight，一个基于分层模块化分解的LLM驱动框架。具体而言，我们首先提出了“二进制图”，这是一种由四个图组成的新数据结构，用于全面表示二进制文件。然后，基于二进制图，我们将函数分层分解为模块并选出最重要的模块。最后，BinXSight生成……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了BinXSight框架，通过引入由四个图组成的新型“二进制图”数据结构，并利用基于LLM的分层模块化分解方法选择关键模块，实现了快速且全面的程序级二进制代码摘要。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes BinXSight, an LLM-powered framework that introduces a novel "binary graph" data structure composed of four graphs and leverages hierarchical modular decomposition to select the most significant modules, achieving fast and comprehensive program-level binary code summarization.
